links.outcome: Availability of model input variables in structured national EHR data for risk score calculation
links.effect: Using structured data only 33/51,275 identified as low risk and 308/51,275 (<1%) as moderate risk; with approximation and free text 18,895 (37%) low and 2125 (4%) moderate; no high-risk identified because waist-hip ratio was missing.
links.quote: We found that Kanta currently lacks many CLivD risk model input parameters in the structured format required to calculate precise risk scores.

unlisted_practices: Approximating missing model inputs using diagnosis codes and unstructured free-text extraction
Simulating scenarios to improve national EHR capture of missing risk-model input variables such as waist-hip ratio

screen.reason: The study tests implementation feasibility and strategies for handling missing inputs (using free text and proxies) to deploy a predictive risk model on a national EHR platform.

primary.practice: handling missing input variables and data integration from unstructured text
